meta.title: Strongest governor — Kingshot 777
meta.description: TL;DR guide to the Kingshot Strongest Governor event: the 7 daily stages, how points are scored, and which rankings pay out.

tldr.heading: TL;DR
items: If KvK is close, save your speed-ups for it. KvK's server-wide build, research and training buffs mean the same speed-ups buy far more power there than in a normal Strongest Governor week.
Bank everything beforehand. Nothing you do outside the event window scores. Sit on your speed-ups and resources and dump them on the matching day.
250,000 points is the bar to qualify for the kingdom-wide rewards. Aim for it even if you can't rank.
Grab your 2 Challenge Medals every day — free rewards for tasks you're already doing.

stages.heading: The 7 days
items: Day 1 — City construction: building upgrades and construction speed-ups.
Day 2 — Hero development: hero EXP, shards, star-ups.
Day 3 — Skill upgrades: hero skill levels.
Day 4 — Troop training: training and promoting troops.
Day 5 — Skill upgrades again.
Day 6 — Troop training again.
Day 7 — Hero development + gathering.

rewards.heading: Rewards
items: Point milestones: 5 tiers per day, each needing more points than the last. Claim them as you go.
Challenge Medal rewards: claimed with the medals you earn, up to 2 per day.
Daily stage ranking: paid at the end of each day to the top 1,000 scorers in your kingdom — gems and speed-ups, scaled by rank.
Kingdom total ranking: top 1,000 in your kingdom by total points across the 7 days.
Cross-kingdom ranking: top 2,000 across all participating kingdoms. Much better rewards — Truegold and exclusive cosmetics — and much harder.
Kingdom rewards: given to everyone in a participating kingdom based on where the kingdom places, but you must personally earn 250,000 points to qualify.

tips.heading: Tips
items: Stockpile before the event. Hold speed-ups, hero EXP, shards and Truegold and spend them only on the matching day.
Pick one day to go big. Daily stage rewards are per-day, so concentrating your hoard on a single stage ranks you higher than spreading it thin.
Skills and troops come round twice (days 3/5 and 4/6). Split your skill books and training between the pair rather than blowing everything on the first.
Queue long upgrades to finish inside the window. Points land when the action completes, not when you start it.
Claim milestones and medals daily. They don't carry over.

qa.a: A recurring competition where every governor scores points for developing their city. It runs for seven days and is split into seven stages, one per day.
By finishing the actions that match the day's theme — upgrading buildings, levelling heroes, upgrading skills, training or promoting troops, burning speed-ups, and consuming rare resources.
A separate daily currency. You can earn up to 2 a day from tasks; spend them in the Challenge Medal Rewards tab. The more you've collected, the better the tier you can claim.

qa.q: Which ranking should I care about?
qa.a: If you're competitive, the cross-kingdom total ranking pays best — Truegold and exclusive cosmetics — but you're up against every participating kingdom. Otherwise focus on point milestones and hitting 250,000 total.

qa.q: Does spending outside the event count?
qa.a: No. Only actions completed during the event window score points.
